character-head.label: Character Head
character-head.description: Generate a channel mascot head — chỉ đầu, không cổ/vai

options.label: comic ink
options.prompt: bold black ink outlines, cel shading, high contrast comic book art, clean white highlights

options.label: semi-real cartoon
options.prompt: semi-realistic cartoon style, soft gradients, painterly shading, appealing proportions

options.label: flat vector
options.prompt: flat vector illustration, solid colors, clean geometric shapes, minimal shading

options.label: 3D render
options.prompt: stylized 3D render, soft studio lighting, smooth materials, Pixar-like polish

options.label: minimal mascot
options.prompt: minimalist mascot design, simple shapes, thick outlines, limited color palette

options.label: friendly
options.prompt: warm friendly smile, approachable open expression

options.label: confident
options.prompt: confident smirk, chin slightly raised, self-assured look

options.label: focused
options.prompt: focused determined look, slightly furrowed brows

options.label: energetic
options.prompt: energetic excited expression, wide eyes, big open smile

options.label: surprised
options.prompt: surprised expression, raised eyebrows, wide open eyes

character-head.promptTemplate: A {{style}} cartoon character head of a young man. {{expression}}. {{angle}}. {{#accessory}}Wearing {{accessory}}. {{/accessory}}Short dark hair, big expressive eyes. Warm orange and amber color palette. Floating on pure white background. ONLY the head — nothing below the jawline. Like an emoji or avatar icon.

pose-body.label: Pose Body
pose-body.description: Generate a body in a specific pose (chưa active — dùng stock photo)
pose-body.promptTemplate: Full body stock photo of a person {{pose}}, plain studio background, professional photography. Headless — cropped at neck.
